title: Two Sum
description: Given two integers a and b, find and print their sum.
input_format: First line contains two space-separated integers a and b.
output_format: Print a single integer - the sum of a and b.

title: Reverse String
description: Given a string s, return the string reversed.
input_format: A single line containing the string s.

title: Palindrome Check
description: Given a string s, determine if it is a palindrome. A palindrome reads the same forward and backward. Print 'YES' if it is a palindrome, otherwise print 'NO'. Ignore case.
input_format: A single line containing the string s (only alphabetic characters).
explanation: racecar reversed is racecar so it is a palindrome.

title: Find Maximum
description: Given an array of n integers, find the maximum element.
input_format: First line contains integer n. Second line contains n space-separated integers.

title: FizzBuzz
description: Given an integer n, print numbers from 1 to n. For multiples of 3 print 'Fizz', for multiples of 5 print 'Buzz', and for multiples of both print 'FizzBuzz'.
output_format: Print n lines, each containing the number or Fizz/Buzz/FizzBuzz.

title: Count Vowels
description: Given a string s, count the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in it. Consider both uppercase and lowercase.
input_format: A single line containing the string s.
output_format: Print a single integer - the count of vowels.
explanation: H-e-l-l-o W-o-r-l-d has vowels e, o, o = 3

title: Factorial
description: Given a non-negative integer n, compute n! (n factorial).
output_format: Print n! as a single integer.

title: Fibonacci Number
description: Given an integer n, find the nth Fibonacci number. The sequence starts with F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1.

title: Sort Array
description: Given an array of n integers, sort them in ascending order and print the sorted array.
input_format: First line contains integer n. Second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print n space-separated integers in ascending order.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of n integers and a target value, determine if the target exists. Print the 0-based index if found, otherwise print -1.
input_format: First line: integer n. Second line: n sorted integers. Third line: target integer.
